reflect_en: David prayed with confidence because he knew who God is: kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on Him. As this week comes to a close, whatever distress you've carried, you can call on Him too, and trust that He hears.
q_en: What do you want to call on God about this weekend?
x_en: In the day of my distress I call on You, because You answer me.
tiktok: Call on Him, He answers 🙏 Psalm 86:5–7 — kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion
yt_title: In the Day of My Distress I Call on You | Psalm 86:5–7 #Shorts
li_open: The best leaders are easy to approach on hard days.
li_quote: For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.
li_body: David called on God in his distress because he trusted God's character: kind, forgiving and rich in loving devotion. Leaders who reflect that kindness, and make it simple for their people to ask for prayer when life is hard, build communities where no one has to face distress alone.
hook_es: Clama a Él. Él te responde. 🙏
reflect_es: David oró con confianza porque conocía a su Dios: bueno y perdonador, y grande en misericordia para con todos los que le invocan. Al cerrar esta semana, sea cual sea la angustia que has cargado, tú también puedes llamarle y confiar en que Él te escucha.
q_es: ¿Por qué quieres clamar a Dios este fin de semana?
x_es: En el día de mi angustia te llamaré: porque tú me respondes.
